name: Apply Wall Primer (Spray, No Backroll)
intent: Spray PVA primer onto bare drywall, no backroll. Used when builder-grade schedule demands speed over mud-joint compaction — common on production NC. Single coat regardless of QT.
doctrine: Spray-only prime (no backroll) — reuses the wall finish task TSK_SPRAY_WALL_FINISH_ONLY (650 SF/hr). TRADE_MATERIAL fires (eligibility.material:true) → WB_PRIMER 1.25× time multiplier. Used when builder-grade schedule favors speed over mud-joint compaction.
